candidates.label: Acute embolic stroke secondary to thoracic aortic thrombus
missing_or_uncertain: Confirmation that aortic thrombus is the embolic source
Exclusion of other embolic sources (e.g., cardiac thrombus)

candidates.label: Acute embolic stroke due to cardioembolic source (heart failure with reduced ejection fraction)
Acute embolic stroke of undetermined source (cryptogenic)
Acute ischemic stroke due to aortic dissection
Acute ischemic stroke due to carotid artery stenosis

response.rationale: The presence of an intraluminal clot in the thoracic aorta on CTA, combined with multiple acute embolic infarcts on MRI, strongly supports an embolic stroke from an aortic source. The negative CT/CTA of the head and neck rules out carotid or vertebral dissection and large vessel occlusion. The prior reduced EF is less likely given the recovered EF and the direct aortic finding.
